title: Leashing the Inner Demons: Self-Detoxification for Language Models
measurement_description: The paper measures the percentage of toxic passages generated by language models in response to natural prompts and adversarial triggers, some of which contain terms for religious groups (e.g., 'Muslims', 'Jews'). This is part of a broader evaluation of a self-detoxification method.
findings: Adversarial triggers containing religious terms (e.g., 'Muslims') caused the baseline GPT-2 model to generate a high percentage of toxic content (up to 82%). The proposed self-detoxification method successfully reduced this toxicity to levels comparable to or better than a supervised baseline (PPLM), for instance, reducing toxicity for one trigger from 64% to 8%. Similar reductions were observed for natural prompts like 'Jews' (from 12% down to 4%).
